steps.name: Misha
steps.text: Nngh...

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: What's wrong with her...?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: It's an acute symptom of Oripathy!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But it's only been a week...!

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: There's also an acute form of Oripathy?

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Franka, which type is yours?

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: What, are you concerned about me?

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Amiya, if Franka passes away, I hope that Rhodes Island will cremate her.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Hey!

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: That's mean, Liskarm!

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: You're the one who's always talking about passing the infection on to me!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Aha... Ahaha...!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: The difference between the acute and chronic types is a rather complicated topic.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: However, Misha's condition is very dangerous.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: If we don't do anything, this condition will become life threatening very quickly.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: All we can do is give her some emergency treatment...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But we must control Misha's symptoms as quickly as possible.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: We have to make this clear to Lungmen. After this ends, we have to bring Misha with us back to Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: This is part of our responsibility.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Um...

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Is she... going to explode soon?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Oww! That hurt! Why'd you hit me...

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Watch your mouth.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Ughh...

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: If I'm going to explode one day, I'll make sure to crawl up to you.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: I'm sorry! Miss Franka, please forgive me for everything I've done!

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Pfft...

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Let's transfer her to a safe place first.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: By the way, we seem to have a situation behind us.

steps.name: Infected
steps.text: What are you doing? ! Get out! !

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: We're all fellow Infected here, don't make us resort to violence! Get out of our way!

steps.name: Infected
steps.text: You've already destroyed our home, and now you're trying to get the L.G.D. here?! Forget it! !

steps.name: Infected
steps.text: You little...! You ignorant fool, get out of the way! !

steps.name: Infected
steps.text: Argh!!

steps.name: Infected
steps.text: Now you've done it!

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: (Are we going to step in?)

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: (We seem to have finally lost them. But if we intervene now, we're going to be exposed.)

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: (Is this going to get in the way of our mission? If so, how serious are the consequences going to be?)

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: (Of course this is going to interfere, but...)

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: (It won't be that serious, right?)

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Let's do it, then.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Rhodes Island's unequivocal mission to save the Infected, as long as the situation permits.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Mmhm, good.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: I knew following you was the right decision.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: What do you mean by that, Miss Franka?

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Don't worry, don't worry! I was just complimenting you!

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: She probably thinks that she can get along well with you.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: How do you know me so well?

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Probably because you're so annoying?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Ugh...

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: It's time to teach these thugs a lesson.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Be careful of the enemies who can jump between buildings.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: In addition, make sure to protect Lungmen's Infected civilians!

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: That's asking for a lot.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: --But, I'll handle it.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: All right, let's go!

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Dr. {@nickname}, make sure to lead me and Texas well!
